title: Induced subdivisions in graphs of large girth
summary: In this paper, we prove that there exists an absolute constant $g_0$ such that, for every integer $k\ge 3$, every graph $G$ with $δ(G)\ge k$ and $g(G)\ge g_0$ contains an induced subdivision of $K_{k+1}$. This fully resolves a problem raised by Kühn and Osthus (originally attributed to Shi), and improves a recent result of Girão and Hunter. Our proof uses some ideas from Girão and Hunter.
